detail.title: [CI][Tests] Upgrade torch version for Rubin prerelease

files.patch:
@@ -4,11 +4,10 @@
 # (vllm-project/vllm#49735).
 --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu134
 
-# Match each architecture's torch pin to the latest torchvision wheel.
-torch==2.15.0.dev20260928+cu134; platform_machine == "x86_64"
-torch==2.15.0.dev20260926+cu134; platform_machine == "aarch64"
-torchvision==0.30.0.dev20260928+cu134
-torchaudio==2.11.0.dev20260928+cu134
+# Use the same nightly pins for x86_64 and aarch64.
+torch==2.16.0.dev20261009+cu134
+torchvision==0.30.0.dev20261009+cu134
+torchaudio==2.11.0.dev20261009+cu134
 
 cuda-python==13.4.1
 cuda-bindings==13.4.1
